QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_31

question.text: All AIFs investing in listed equities must mandatorily follow which code as per SEBI Circular dated December 24, 2019?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (pages 123 and 179-180), the SEBI Circular dated December 24, 2019 mandates the Stewardship Code for all AIFs in relation to investment in listed equities, supported by internal controls and periodic reporting to SEBI, clients, and beneficiaries. The Trap: Options A, B, and C are separate regulatory regimes that are not the listed-equity stewardship code mandated for AIFs by the December 24, 2019 circular. Note: The Stewardship Code obligations apply to all AIFs investing in listed equities and require both internal controls and periodic reporting.
